sources.rbdmap: RBDmap (Castello et al. 2016 Mol Cell, HeLa) Table S1 RBDpep: RNA-bound proteolytic fragments (Oxford Research Archive)
sources.capri: CAPRI (Panhale et al. 2019 Nat Commun, HEK293, CC BY 4.0) Supplementary Data 9 and 3: RNA-crosslinked peptides (XL-peptides) and the Lys-C peptides next to crosslinks (ADJ-peptides). The searches did not allow methylarginine, so a peptide with a methylarginine could be identified only from molecules in which that arginine was unmethylated
sources.pclap: pCLAP (Mullari et al. 2017 J Proteome Res, HEK293, UV crosslinking): RNA-binding peptides derived by scripts/43d_stage_pclap.py from the PRIDE PXD005739 MaxQuant search (XL against No XL, the authors' published rule), their Lys-C peptides (the authors' RNA-binding regions) and every measured peptide. The search did not allow methylarginine
sources.rbrid: RBR-ID (Oksuz et al. 2023 Mol Cell, K562 nuclei, 4SU and 312 nm UV; PRIDE PXD035484, CC0), staged by scripts/43c_stage_rbrid.py from the DIA-NN report: residues under RBR-ID+ peptides (log2 +4SU/-4SU < 0, p < 0.05, the published cut-off) with their residue scores (He et al. 2016), regions of smoothed residue score >= 3, and every residue measured. The search did not allow methylarginine
sources.rna_crosslinks: pepR-MS (Sha, Kuster & Trendel, bioRxiv 2025, CC BY-NC) Tables S2-S3: RNA-crosslinked residues re-analysed from Kramer 2014, XRNAX 2019, RBS-ID 2020, pRBS-ID 2021 and pepR-MS
